maintenance_led.reason: Sells first-time consumer purchases of home, fashion, beauty and electronics via QVC and HSN video shopping; not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers buying products on TV, streaming, social and web channels, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its QVC and HSN video commerce sales, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily buy similar home, fashion and beauty goods from other retailers with no switching cost.
